verdict.rationale: Fathom offers detailed API reference docs (endpoints like get-transcript, get-summary, list-users) plus a quickstart with example calls and SDKs, but there is no evidence of an interactive/runnable playground (e.g., Swagger/OpenAPI UI) — probes for openapi.json/swagger.json all returned 404. missing for 10: interactive try-it-now console, published OpenAPI spec, independent confirmation of runnable examples in-browser.
